description:
Grab bag of small nits, all safe to land in one commit:

1. Remove mix new scaffold leftovers: OctoPi.Agent.hello/0, OctoPi.Coder.hello/0, OctoPi.TUI.hello/0 (+ their doctests + the boilerplate comments in each Application module).

2. Strip stale ticket IDs from moduledocs (opi-y1y.2, opi-y1y.3 refs in noop_keychain and request.ex — cited by the fidelity reviewer).

3. Replace emoji arrows in mix ai.demo (→, ←, ✗) with ASCII equivalents per house style.

4. URL trimming idiom: Request.trim_trailing_slash/1 uses String.slice(url, 0..-2//1); replace with String.trim_trailing(url, \"/\").

5. Mark Decoder.State and SSE.t() as @opaque (docstring already says \"do not pattern-match externally\").

6. KeychainReader.read/1 wrapper rescue drops all errors silently — drop the wrapper, call module.read() directly. The behaviour's documented contract already says implementations must not raise; trust it.

7. Provider @callback: change Enumerable.t() → Enumerable.t(Event.t()); mark stream_simple/3 as @optional_callbacks (Phase 1 aliases it to stream/3).

8. Decoder.finalize/1 on nil stop_reason: raise ArgumentError instead of silently synthesizing :error. A real bug in Anthropic's event order should surface loudly.

TDD for each:
- Most are safe refactors: existing tests stay green.
- For #8, RED: update the existing test that asserts \"stream ended without stop_reason\" message → asserts ArgumentError raised.

Files: various — see review output.
title: Scaffold + idiom cleanup: hello/0 stubs, template comments, ticket IDs, emojis, trim_trailing
